phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, heavy economy and moderate production, facing a Terran with unknown posture but heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a clear read on the Terran's composition or when you are ready to expand.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on economy and production growth, tech development, and maintaining expansion; avoid tech overcommitment without scouting.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy and production while developing technology; maintain current expansion and prepare for midgame.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Tech and Economy Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to a specific tech path without scouting, risking vulnerability to early pressure or wrong composition.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, heavy economy and production, facing a Terran ground posture with heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have secured a third base or when you detect a change in Terran strategy.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Boost economy and production, strengthen ground forces, consider expansion, and keep defense solid.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy and production, strengthen ground army, and consider expanding to secure more resources while maintaining defense.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Ground Tech Investment
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-extend economy without proper defense, leaving you vulnerable to harassment like Reapers.

phase_policies.applies_when: Reaching the midgame with a heavy economy and production, facing a Terran ground posture with heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see a shift in Terran composition (e.g., more air units) or when you are ready to take a more aggressive stance.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop ground army and tech, increase production and economy, maintain expansion, and stay active with defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing ground army and technology, increase production and economy, maintain current expansion count, and keep defense watchful.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Macro Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not passively strengthen ground and tech without pushing or scouting, allowing the enemy to amass a large force.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, heavy economy and production, facing a Terran ground posture with heavy tech and moderate air presence.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see a clear Terran tech switch or when you are ready to push for a decisive engagement.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Reinforce ground army and tech, maintain economy and production, solidify defense, and prepare for a decisive engagement.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and technology, maintain economy and production, keep defense solid, and consider adding more tech units.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army Reinforcement
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defense while over-investing in tech or economy, leaving you vulnerable to harassment or a decisive enemy push.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
